name: Ragna**k - Shoku Chu Doku
original_name: ラグナ○ク 触・中・毒
source:
A millennium past since the holy war between god, human race, and monsters.....

The long-time peace of the Rune-Midgard Kingdom is now coming to an end.

Rich green inland, dreary desert area, deep forest, and dungeon where monsters dwell in.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ014540.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
神、人类与怪物之间的圣战已过去一千年……

卢恩-米德加尔特王国长久以来的和平，如今即将结束。

这里有葱郁的内陆地区、荒凉的沙漠、幽深森林，以及怪物栖居的地下城。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ014540.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
